mapper.select: SELECT app_code, app_name, source_system, owner, ip_whitelist, permission_scope, status, status_type, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_gateway_app ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT certificate_code, gateway_code, certificate_version, DATE_FORMAT(expire_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expireAt, status, status_type, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_gateway_certificate ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT permission_code, app_code, scope, status, status_type, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_gateway_permission ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, app_code AS appCode, app_name AS appName, source_system AS sourceSystem, owner, ip_whitelist AS ipWhitelist, permission_scope AS permissionScope, status, status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_gateway_app WHERE app_code = #{appCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, gateway_code AS gatewayCode, gateway_name AS gatewayName, channel_type AS channelType, protocol_type AS protocolType, sign_algorithm AS signAlgorithm, endpoint, status, status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_gateway_channel WHERE gateway_code = #{gatewayCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, certificate_code AS certificateCode, gateway_code AS gatewayCode, certificate_version AS certificateVersion, DATE_FORMAT(expire_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expireAt, status, status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_gateway_certificate WHERE certificate_code = #{certificateCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, permission_code AS permissionCode, app_code AS appCode, scope, status, status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_gateway_permission WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT route_code AS routeCode, gateway_code AS gatewayCode, environment, release_strategy AS releaseStrategy, traffic_percent AS trafficPercent, release_window AS releaseWindow, status, status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_gateway_release_route WHERE route_code = #{routeCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_gateway_channel WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_gateway_certificate WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_gateway_permission WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_gateway_app SET status = #{status}, status_type = #{statusType}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE app_code = #{appCode}
UPDATE t_gateway_channel SET status = #{status}, status_type = #{statusType}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE gateway_code = #{gatewayCode}
UPDATE t_gateway_certificate SET status = #{status}, status_type = #{statusType}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE certificate_code = #{certificateCode}
UPDATE t_gateway_permission SET status = #{status}, status_type = #{statusType}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode}
UPDATE t_gateway_release_route SET status = #{status}, status_type = #{statusType}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE route_code = #{routeCode}
